lines.text: The LORD sets Ezekiel down in the middle of a valley full of very dry bones.
God says He will cause breath to enter the bones, and then they will know that He is the LORD.
As Ezekiel prophesies, there is a trumpet, and the bones come together, and tendons, flesh and skin cover them.
Ezekiel prophesies to the breath to come from the high mountains, and the bodies stand as a vast army.
God promises to open the graves of Israel, put His Spirit in them, and settle them in their own land.
